aggregate_adjudication.assessment: The single raw error is the inherited heuristic requiring a capacitor directly on +12V. Fresh connectivity shows +12V is only J2-to-F1; no IC supply pin is on this segment. Input bypassing C65/C66 is on protected VIN_RAW. This does not establish a critical decoupling defect. Five missing dedicated rail test-point suggestions remain optional; accessible rail pads/headers exist. Direct ERC/DRC/connectivity outrank this heuristic verdict.

remaining_risks.item: Measure startup, rail drop, device temperature and required input-removal/reversal transients with the actual adapter and load. Single P-MOS protection is not an ideal diode while on; U12 downstream reverse-current blocking is retained.

Do not guarantee exactly -10 V gate drive from the low-current zener bias. Conservative 25 °C resistance estimate is 35 mΩ, yielding about 0.144 W at 2.03 A; hot resistance and actual copper determine temperature.
U5 reset timing and the FA0520E rail upper-tolerance margin remain unchanged and user-accepted for this prototype. They are not validated by clean CAD checks.

valve_control: Existing TCA9534 binary on/off retained; appropriate to the specified two-position FA0520E. No unqualified PWM/proportional behavior introduced.
